title: Evaluation after circuit restriction
statement: Let $m,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $p$ be an assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ variables, and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on those variables. For every assignment $y$ to the first $m$ variables, restricting $C$ to those variables and replacing each literal whose index is at least $m$ by its value under $p$ gives a circuit whose value at $y$ equals the value of $C$ on the assignment that uses $y_i$ for indices $i<m$ and $p_i$ for indices $i\ge m$.
hypotheses_covered: Padding assignment p on n variables
Boolean circuit C on n variables
